messages.subject: For Geoff Martha | Medtech, government relations and global stakeholder strategy
messages.body:
Dear Medtronic Investor Relations Team,

Please place this executive introduction before Mr. Geoff Martha, Chairman and Chief Executive Officer.

Medtronic's global medical-technology platform operates across governments, regulators, health systems, communities and major investment priorities. That stakeholder environment closely matches my current leadership mandate.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My responsibilities span government and regulatory relations, ESG, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and executive advisory, with senior institutional engagement across complex regulated operations.

I would welcome a senior discussion about where this combination of government relations, ESG and stakeholder execution might support Medtronic's priorities. My attached CV has been tailored specifically to Medtronic.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com
